svg.title: A branched cable and four voltage probes
svg.desc: Synthetic neuronal cable: 3 mm trunk and two 2 mm daughters. Trunk and upper daughter radius 5 µm; lower daughter radius 3.5 µm. A total inward current of 0.006 µA acts at the start from 1 to 2 ms. Junction and distal probes cross zero later than the stimulated start; the thinner lower daughter arrives later in this experiment. Diagram coordinates do not affect physical path length.
